thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem 1 recurring noisy pages from the inference autoscaler over the past 3 weeks. want to lock owners + short timeline for suppression + dedupe changes :eyes:
Liam: saw that. most are duplicate bursts from the same task id when the node drains. suggested: 1) increase dedupe window to 10m, 2) suppress after 3 repeats in 5m, 3) add cluster_id to dedupe key
Sara: +1. also we should add a cheap metric-based guard to avoid paging on transient flaps (eg only page if error_rate > 5% for 2 consecutive 1m windows)
Maya: can someone volunteer to own the changes? need a PR and config rollout by EOD Friday. Ravi?
Ravi: I can take ownership of the suppression rules and monitor. will open the PR today and tag staging for canary.
Liam: i'll handle dedupe key change in alert-router, add cluster_id, and bump window. should be a small rollout.
Sara: i'll draft the metric guard rule and a short playbook snippet for oncall so they know when to un-silence. putting reference links in the PR description.
DevOps-Bot: deploy-triggered: CI started for branch refs/heads/auto/dedupe-window-update (build 4721)
Maya: thanks. can we enumerate action items and ETA in this thread? helps the PM follow-up.
Ravi: action: update suppression policy (owner: Ravi) ETA: 2025-03-12 18:00 UTC. PR: https://git.internal/rw/infra/ops/1234
Liam: action: update alert-router dedupe key + window (owner: Liam) ETA: 2025-03-12 16:00 UTC. PR: https://git.internal/rw/router/987
Sara: action: add metric guard + playbook blurb (owner: Sara) ETA: 2025-03-13 12:00 UTC. PR: https://git.internal/rw/monitoring/555
Maya: also want recurring incident tracking: we'll tag any future page with label "inference-noise" and run weekly sweep to check effectiveness for 4 weeks. owner for sweep: Maya/SRE rotation.
Ravi: noted. I'll add a dashboard panel for noise-suppression rate and a simple query: sum(pages{label=\"inference-noise\"}) by cluster over 1w
Liam: one operational note 1 when changing dedupe key, older dedupe buckets won't match so initial burst might still page. plan to do a controlled rollout region-by-region.
Sara: put a short note in the PR about rollback steps: set dedupe window back and toggle suppression flag off. also add a quick-runbook snippet:
```
# quick un-silence
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://ops-api/release/suppression/disable?rule=autoscaler-noise
// revert config from canary to stable
```
Maya: perfect. please paste final PR links + canary plan here when ready. i'll close the postmortem followup once all three PRs merged and we have 2 weeks of reduced paging. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/infrastructure/1234 - includes canary rollout to us-west-2 and smoke tests. tagging @oncall-team
Liam: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/alert-router/987 - canary to us-west, staged in us-east next day
Sara: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/monitoring/555 - playbook added under docs/oncall/auto-suppression.md
Maya: thanks team. i'll run the weekly sweep on Monday and share numbers. if anything slips, ping this thread and escalate to eng-sre. :pray:
